description.summary: screen content capturing on client buffers

protocol.description: This protocol allows clients to ask the compositor to copy part of the screen content to a client buffer.

description.summary: manager to inform clients and begin capturing

request.name: capture_output
request.description: Capture the next frame of an entire output.

request.name: capture_output_region
request.description: Capture the next frame of an output's region, given in output logical coordinates and clipped to the output's extents.

interface.name: zwlr_screencopy_frame_v1
interface.description: Buffer events describe the supported buffer types, then buffer_done. After copy, flags + ready, or failed.

entry.name: already_used
entry.summary: the object has already been used to copy a wl_buffer

description.summary: indicates frame is available for reading

arg.name: tv_sec_hi
arg.summary: high 32 bits of the seconds part of the timestamp

arg.name: tv_sec_lo
arg.summary: low 32 bits of the seconds part of the timestamp

description.summary: delete this object, used or not
copy the frame when it's damaged
carries the coordinates of the damaged region
